nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the current contract owner, set to msg.sender in the constructor and updated in acceptOwnership.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner set by transferOwnership and consumed/zeroed by acceptOwnership.
DesignerClubCoin.balances: mapping(address=>uint) token balances, mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
DesignerClubCoin.allowed: nested allowance mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) written by approve/approveAndCall and decremented by transferFrom.
DesignerClubCoin._totalSupply: fixed 10,000,000,000 * 10**18 supply minted to a hardcoded address in the constructor.
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender, establishing unconditional caller-controlled ownership.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner): onlyOwner-gated two-step ownership handover; rejects address(0).
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, moves owner to newOwner and zeroes newOwner.
DesignerClubCoin constructor: sets metadata, mints _totalSupply and assigns the entire balance to a fixed address.
DesignerClubCoin.totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] (burn accounting).
DesignerClubCoin.balanceOf(address tokenOwner): read-only accessor over the balances mapping.
DesignerClubCoin.transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender via safeSub and credits 'to' via safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
DesignerClubCoin.approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
DesignerClubCoin.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): spends allowance and moves balances using safeSub/safeAdd; requires to != 0x0.
DesignerClubCoin.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): read-only accessor over the allowed mapping.
DesignerClubCoin.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): writes allowance then performs an arbitrary external call to spender.receiveApproval before returning.
DesignerClubCoin fallback function: payable and unconditionally reverts, rejecting all plain Ether transfers.
DesignerClubCoin.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens): onlyOwner function that performs an external transfer on an arbitrary token contract.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): checked addition with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): checked subtraction with require(b <= a) underflow guard.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, allowance keys and balance accounting.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) with an attacker-chosen spender contract and unconstrained calldata.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary, caller-supplied token contract address.

edges.reason: Ownership is assigned directly from msg.sender in the constructor, so the deployer-controlled caller becomes owner.
OnlyOwner modifier enforces msg.sender == owner before ownership can be handed over.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner; caller identity is the sole authorization check.
transfer reads and debits balances[msg.sender], so caller identity selects the source balance.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], keying the allowance on the caller.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender], so the caller determines whose allowance is consumed.
The caller identity msg.sender is forwarded as the 'from' argument into the external receiveApproval callback.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by onlyOwner, restricting arbitrary token sweeps to the owner.
Constructor writes owner = msg.sender, establishing privileged state from an untrusted caller address.
transferOwnership stages the new owner in newOwner; ownership change requires acceptOwnership by that address.
acceptOwnership moves owner to newOwner, transferring all onlyOwner privileges.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0), clearing the pending handover slot.
Constructor sets the fixed _totalSupply from decimals.
Constructor assigns the entire supply to a hardcoded holder address in balances.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply as the base supply value.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] to net out burned tokens.
balanceOf returns the entry of the balances mapping.
transfer mutates two entries of the balances mapping (sender debit, recipient credit).
transfer relies on safeAdd for the recipient credit, whose correctness depends on its require(c >= a) guard.
transfer relies on safeSub for the sender debit, whose require(b <= a) guard prevents underflow.
approve overwrites the nested allowance entry allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom credits the recipient balance after debiting the source balance.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] by the transferred amount.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the destination balance credit.
transferFrom uses safeSub for both the source balance and the allowance debit.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before performing the external call.
approveAndCall invokes the untrusted spender contract via receiveApproval, transferring control to externally supplied code.
The external callee can re-enter transferFrom and drain the freshly written allowance entry before approveAndCall returns.
Control returns from the untrusted receiveApproval call back into approveAndCall, allowing state to be observed/modified mid-execution.
transferAnyERC20Token delegates execution to a caller-supplied token contract through a low-level interface call.
The arbitrary token contract can re-enter DesignerClubCoin before transferAnyERC20Token completes.
Recovered tokens are sent to the owner state variable used as the transfer recipient.
Parameter a is the first operand of the unchecked-in-source addition protected by the overflow require.
Parameter b is the second addition operand in safeAdd.
Parameter a is the minuend checked by require(b <= a) in safeSub.
Parameter b is the subtrahend in safeSub.
Parameter _newOwner flows into the transferOwnership handover logic.
Parameter _newOwner is written into the newOwner state variable, arming a future privilege transfer.
Parameter tokenOwner is used as the lookup key in balanceOf.
Parameter to is the recipient key credited in transfer.
Parameter tokens is the amount debited and credited in transfer.
Parameter spender is the second key of the allowance entry written by approve.
Parameter tokens is stored as the allowance value by approve.
Parameter from is the debited balance key and the allowance owner key in transferFrom.
Parameter to is the credited recipient key and is checked non-zero in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the amount moved and the allowance debit in transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner is the first lookup key in allowance.
Parameter spender is the second lookup key in allowance.
Parameter spender is both the allowance beneficiary and the address of the untrusted external call target.
Parameter tokens is written as the allowance and forwarded to the external callback.
Parameter data is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call, giving the callee arbitrary calldata control.
Parameter tokenAddress determines the target contract of the external transfer call, enabling a malicious callee.
Parameter tokens determines the amount requested from the external token contract in transferAnyERC20Token.

Parameter b is only consumed by SafeMath.safeAdd; fold it into that core function node.

Parameter tokenOwner is only a lookup key for the balances mapping inside balanceOf; fold it into dcc_balanceOf.
Parameter to is only used as the credit key inside transfer; fold it into dcc_transfer.
Parameter tokens is only the moved amount inside transfer; fold it into dcc_transfer.
Parameter spender is only the allowance key inside approve; fold it into dcc_approve.
Parameter tokens is only the stored allowance value inside approve; fold it into dcc_approve.
Parameter from is only used for balance/allowance keys inside transferFrom; fold it into dcc_transferFrom.
Parameter to is only the credited recipient inside transferFrom; fold it into dcc_transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is only the moved amount and allowance debit inside transferFrom; fold it into dcc_transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner is only a read key inside allowance; fold it into dcc_allowance.
Parameter spender is only a read key inside allowance; fold it into dcc_allowance.
Parameter spender directly determines the target contract of the untrusted external call; fold it into the unsafe receiveApproval call node.
Parameter tokens is only the recorded allowance and forwarded amount inside approveAndCall; fold it into dcc_approveAndCall.
Parameter data is forwarded verbatim as arbitrary calldata to the untrusted contract; fold it into the unsafe receiveApproval call node.
Parameter tokenAddress selects the external callee contract and is the core of the untrusted call; fold it into the unsafe ERC20 transfer call node.
Parameter tokens is only the requested amount of the sweep; fold it into dcc_transferAnyERC20Token.
